summary: Frontend validation of Wave-A WP-A1 Shield confidentiality register lifecycle at /os/admin/govern. Exercised DPO author -> pending -> approve -> in-force -> propose retirement -> master_admin countersign -> countdown -> cancel -> withdraw flow, plus reach report, vault invalid file-id, read-only operator role, forbidden analyst role, and mobile layout. Also ran API negatives via curl. All scripted assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/shield/register/{name}?reason=... is the 'propose retirement' endpoint; carrying a required semantic body (reason) in a URL query of a DELETE is unusual and conflicts with the symmetry of removal/countersign|cancel|apply which are POSTs with JSON bodies. Consider aliasing POST /register/{name}/removal with a JSON body for consistency and OpenAPI clarity.

Vault error from the backend reads 'No such upload in this tenant\'s library'. The acceptance-text in the spec referenced 'No such upload' — the current wording is fine but the test fixture should match reality.
test_credentials: Used demo.dpo / demo.master_admin / demo.operator / demo.analyst on tenant RMS (all from /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: Synthetic category 'ui_probe_hx86l8' authored, approved into force; left clean (no removal in flight) after master_admin cancelled both the UI-proposed and API-proposed ceremonies. 'ui_withdraw_hx86l8' authored & withdrawn (now on record as withdrawn). Safe to re-run; new runs will use a fresh random6 suffix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Wave-A1 UI flows verified. Observations: (1) banner text for retirement proposal is 'Retirement proposal recorded.'; (2) in-force row with ceremony shows 'RETIREMENT PROPOSED' tag; (3) countdown message reads 'Visible countdown runs until …'; (4) analyst role gets no shield-surface (no explicit forbidden testid, but surface absent + readable 'cannot/forbidden/role' text — if a dedicated data-testid='shield-forbidden' banner is desired, main agent should add one). Everything else matches the WP-A1 contract.
